finding: PRINTED: 'Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle. Then if you control four or more lands, untap that land.' ENGINE(observed): with only two lands (the Passage + Forest), the searched Swamp still enters UNTAPPED — 'tapped[s1]: expected True, got False'. The SEARCH atom's args carry no tapped_on_enter (compiler emits tapped_on_enter=None; the executor's _v_search honors the flag at verbs.py:1000, and Cultivate's partition MOVE_ZONE siblings DO emit tapped_on_enter=True — the Fabled SEARCH-delivery template just drops it). The conditional-untap clause is therefore unfalsifiable: the land is already untapped in every branch.
notes: Search/sacrifice/shuffle half is green in fabled_passage.json. d1 Mountain is the LAST library entry so the setup begin_turn draw eats IT, leaving the Swamp findable — without it the 'search' silently no-ops (that was the old FPb probe's confound). Y2 probe: with >=4 lands post-search the land is untapped, which matches the printed conditional-untap clause, so the divergence is isolated to the <4-land branch.
